about:
Newport Sea Salt Co. operates from Newport, Rhode Island, where husband-and-wife team Matt and Tami Mullins founded the business after Matt’s 20-year career as a U.S. Naval Officer. The veteran-owned, woman-owned small business began with a desire to stay connected to the sea and to produce artisanal sea salt using traditional hand-harvesting methods.

The company hand-harvests seawater from Brenton Reef at high tide, filters it, and evaporates it in small batches to produce 100% natural flake sea salt with no additives. The product line includes plain flake salt and blended varieties such as Rosemary & Thyme, Butcher’s Blend, Bella Napoli, and Fire Salt. Production is small-scale, with the Mullins family and their sons Matthew and Connor comprising the crew.

Newport Sea Salt Co. sells directly to consumers at farmers markets and pop-up events across Rhode Island, and through retail partners including specialty food shops, cheese purveyors, and seafood markets in Rhode Island, New York, and California. The salt is also used by restaurant chefs and home cooks as a finishing salt.

The founders emphasize their unhurried, traditional process and the purity of their source water—an approved shellfish-growing area monitored by the Rhode Island Department of Environmental Management. They highlight that their salt retains trace minerals such as calcium, magnesium, and potassium, and contains no anti-caking agents, bleach, or iodine.
